memory_scope: OS high-water process RSS, including decoded discovery JSON, PCM, masks, synthesis and export QA; excludes plots/tests.

model.join_model: Cubic Hermite on min(0.5 ms, 15% cycle duration) per edge. Shared model value/slope at adjacent accepted joins; zero value/slope at gaps.

limits: Residual conservation is bookkeeping, not reconstruction quality.
No anti-alias resynthesis filter; linear 64-position interpolation is lossy.
Ambiguous/provisional/unreliable cycles remain unexplained; no PCM fallback.
Hermite bridges ensure model boundary continuity, not perceptual click-free playback.
No overlapping-source separation or identity count is inferred.
